'''Molecularly agitated cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sold [[molecularly agitated cheese sandwich]]es with a cup of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] as part of its lunch and dinner species on [[Centaxday/Legends|Centaxdays]].<ref name="Menu" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Molecularly agitated cheese was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
